videos.description: "Brooklyn Breeze" is a 2D animated musical short film. It is a visual journey through different parts of Brooklyn shores, from Coney Island to Williamsburg Bridge, some of the iconic spots and others not often seen by visitors.

videos.description: The film chronicles the origin and ongoing meaning of the I HEART NY logo, from its creation during the 1970s economic downturn, to the present day when New York City is in a moment of both prosperity and growing political uncertainty.

videos.title: Tribeca Festival
videos.description: Since 1965, M. Elaine & Cassandra Bromfield, two Black women, made joyful 8mm films of life in Brooklyn's Lindsay Park Housing Co-op. Into My Life pays tribute to the memories, identities, and relationships preserved within their archive.

videos.title: Tribeca Festival
videos.description: Matty "Square" Ruggiero and his childhood friends tell their story of what it was like to grow up in South Brooklyn, where money was tight but friendships were tighter.

videos.title: Tribeca Festival
videos.description: On a late-night ride aboard NYC's G Train, a lone singer clutching a plant captivates amused, confused commuters. Inspired by a four-year-old, Sea Lion Cow is the antithesis to clickbait, a surrealist balm for the soul.

videos.title: Esta isla
videos.description: Young lovers Bebo and Lola flee to a remote part of Puerto Rico in the wake of a murder. As they travel through the island's changing landscape, violence closes in, forcing Bebo to confront his past and choose between redemption or a life on the run.

videos.title: Dog Pound
videos.description: A car thief (Mateo Morales), a drug dealer (Shane Kippel) and a violent criminal (Adam Butcher) face brutal inmates at a correctional facility.

videos.title: If That Mockingbird Don't Sing
videos.description: After being brutally dumped, 17-year-old Sydnie discovers she's pregnant. Seeing this as an opportunity to get her ex back and give her life direction, she decides to keep the baby. She soon realizes this won't be the quick fix she had hoped for and finds herself caught in a complicated love triangle.

videos.title: A Very Merry Breakup
videos.description: Lydia panics and flees home to Los Angeles after her boyfriend, Tim, proposes to her. Forced to wade through a minefield of potential suitors, she soon discovers that the only man for her is him.

videos.title: Newness
videos.description: In Los Angeles, two millennials navigating a social media-driven hookup culture begin a relationship that pushes both emotional and physical boundaries.

videos.title: Wild Goat Surf
videos.description: In a run-down Okanagan RV park during the summer of 2003, surfing-obsessed 12-year-old skater girl Goat navigates the unbridled, unstructured summer days of youth, dreaming about becoming a surfer.

videos.title: The Runway
videos.description: Residents of County Cork help a downed South American pilot who crashed in their town.

videos.title: Good Girl Jane
videos.description: Jane meets a group of teen misfits who offer her acceptance and camaraderie. She falls hard for their playful but domineering ringleader, Jamie, and becomes entangled in his amateur drug operation. Jane must choose between Jamie and her own survival.

videos.title: I Am Big Bird: The Caroll Spinney Story
videos.description: Caroll Spinney is the 80-year-old who has been creating the Muppet characters of Big Bird and Oscar the Grouch since the first season of "Sesame Street.".

videos.title: We Are Pat
videos.description: WE ARE PAT examines the controversial 1990s Saturday Night Live "It's Pat" skits. Director Rowan Haber explores their complicated fascination with the Pat character through the lens of modern trans visibility. From Tribeca Films.

videos.title: Summer in February
videos.description: Two friends at a 1913 British artists' colony compete for the affections of a comely debutante, but the object of their pursuit soon learns to regret her choice.

videos.title: Expecting
videos.description: Lizzie's best friend, Andie, becomes pregnant and offers to give the baby to her. Lizzie's husband, Peter, reluctantly goes along with being the child's father, and Andie moves into the guest room for the remainder of the pregnancy.

videos.title: How to Make Money Selling Drugs
videos.description: Eminem, 50 Cent, Susan Sarandon and others appear in a satirical course for aspiring drug dealers on how to maximize profits and evade prison.

videos.title: November
videos.description: In 19th-century Estonia, Liina may be forced to marry a repulsive farmer and give up her love for Hans.

videos.title: Stand Clear of the Closing Doors
videos.description: Ricky, an autistic teen living in Queens, has a difficult time fitting in at school. He is scolded for skipping class and hides out in the subway as Hurricane Sandy closes in on the city.

videos.title: Buster's Mal Heart
videos.description: An eccentric mountain man is on the run from the authorities, surviving the winter by breaking into empty vacation homes in a remote community. Regularly calling into radio talk shows, where he has acquired the nickname "Buster," to rant about the impending Inversion at the turn of the millennium, he is haunted by visions of being lost at sea, and memories of his former life as a family man.

videos.title: Tribeca Festival
videos.description: The film chronicles the origin and ongoing meaning of the I HEART NY logo, from its creation during the 1970s economic downturn, to the present day when New York City is in a moment of both prosperity and growing political uncertainty.

videos.title: Jonathan
videos.description: Jonathan is an early riser who works at an architecture firm. John is a night owl and a bit of a mess. The only problem is that they inhabit the same body, which works through careful planning -- until things start to fall apart.

videos.title: Reeling
videos.description: After a major accident, Ryan returns home for a birthday luau and uncovers the secret of when things took a tragic turn.

videos.title: #Like
videos.description: Rosie stalks the man who sexploited and bullied her sister after the authorities refuse to get involved, taking justice into her own hands.

videos.title: Red Flag
videos.description: After a painful breakup, a filmmaker (Alex Karpovsky) with an unusual philosophy takes his film on tour.

videos.title: American Violet
videos.description: After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's (Alfre Woodard) advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the Texas criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney (Tim Blake Nelson) and a former narcotics cop (Will Patton).

videos.title: The Broken Circle Breakdown
videos.description: The loss of their young daughter threatens to destroy the love and faith of two married musicians (Veerle Baetens, Johan Heldenbergh).
